entities.summary: Nikita Sergeyevich Zadorov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was originally drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in the first round, 16th overall, in the 2013 NHL entry draft.
